title: Brushed Bronze Cabinet Pull, 3-Inch Center-To-Center, Solid Brass, Cabinet Mount, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Brushed Bronze, cabinet pull for drawers and cabinet doors featuring 3-inch center-to-center mounting (3 inches, 3-inch, 3in) and cabinet mount installation, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. Solid brass cabinet hardware in a traditional style for kitchen or bathroom cabinetry. Overall dimensions: 3.9 in length x 1.6 in height x 0.9 in width; 1 in projection. Supports up to 2 lb. Includes the cabinet pull and all installation hardware. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Use as a cabinet pull handle, drawer pull, cabinet handle, or cabinet door pull; coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
